title: The HTTP DEX poller (a chain without a WebSocket URL) asks for its whole outstanding range in one eth_getLogs, so after an RPC outage longer than the provider log-range limit every poll is refused and the listener stays blind to new pairs until the bot restarts, with only an "HTTP polling error" log line

evidence.note: startHttpPollingListener seeds lastBlock with getBlockNumber() when it starts (V2); the V3 poller the same at :1656
dexFactory.queryFilter('PairCreated', lastBlock + 1, currentBlock): the whole outstanding range in one request, unchunked (V3 :1665 the same for PoolCreated)
lastBlock advances only after a successful poll; a failed tick only logs "HTTP polling error" (V3 :1672-1675, "V3 HTTP polling error"), so the next tick asks for the same, wider range

the repo assumes a 10-block eth_getLogs range on ETH ("Alchemy free-tier safe"; backfillCapBlocks 10, 500 elsewhere), and the chunked getLogsForBackfill exists in src/anti-rug/detector.ts, but the DEX pollers use neither
same code at the Phase 23 HEAD (src unchanged in Phase 23): seed :1634, query :1643, advance :1649, error log :1651; V3 :1656-1679

real path: an ETH chain without a WebSocket URL, the real HTTP DEX poller, a provider refusing eth_getLogs wider than 10 blocks (fixtures/AUD-ANTIRUG-018-range-limit.ts); a 12-block outage of eth_blockNumber while the bot runs, then every factory query asks pre-outage+1..head in one request and is refused, and a launch mined after the outage is never found within 60 s of fake time; a poller catching up in backfillCapBlocks windows reads looks fixed

sibling_sites_checked: Every eth_getLogs / queryFilter caller in src at 23a6461 and HEAD (git grep -n -e "queryFilter(" -e "getLogs(" -- src): the V2 and V3 HTTP DEX pollers (this entry, src/bot.ts), the anti-rug HTTP poller (AUD-ANTIRUG-018, same unchunked shape but resumed from the stored block, so a restart does not clear it), the anti-rug backfill (chunked through getLogsForBackfill, correct), and the V3 Mint wait. Unlike AUD-ANTIRUG-018 a restart clears this one, because the DEX pollers seed at the head on start, and every launch inside the gap is lost. Overlapping ticks of the same poller (no in-flight guard) are AUD-BUY-004; Stop not stopping the HTTP poller is AUD-BUY-011; an RPC rejection of the first getBlockNumber at start is AUD-BUY-005.
severity_rationale: S3, capital none, graded by the 23-10 executor under the operator's standing instruction of 2026-11-11 ("All the bugs are going to get fixed. The S1, 2 or whatever doesn't matter. Don't interrupt sessions to ask me about upgrading or downgrading"), without a stop. No funds are lost, stranded or overspent: held positions keep their exit monitor and anti-rug (which have their own paths), and a blind listener only stops new buys. The harm is operational and silent: on a chain without a WebSocket URL, after an RPC outage longer than the provider range limit (about 2 minutes on ETH at 10 blocks; a limit of 500 elsewhere is about 17 minutes on Base), the bot stops seeing launches on that chain until a restart, while the dashboard shows the chain running and the only signal is a repeating error log line. Exposure is unknown: the operator does not know whether any chain runs without a WebSocket URL (ESC-ANTIRUG-03, "Not sure"). Graded below AUD-ANTIRUG-018 (S1 STRAND) because no held position loses protection.
recommendation: Catch up in provider-sized windows (at most the chain's backfillCapBlocks per request, the same chunking as getLogsForBackfill) and advance lastBlock per window; bound how far a catch-up may go back and alert when a gap is skipped; surface a failing poll as a chain health change instead of a log line. Fix together with AUD-ANTIRUG-018 (one shared chunked poll helper) in Phase 24 or Phase 29.

triage.note: Found by 23-10 while proving AUD-ANTIRUG-018 (the same unchunked eth_getLogs range in the DEX pollers). Proven on the real path: an ETH chain without a WebSocket URL, the real HTTP DEX poller, a provider refusing eth_getLogs wider than 10 blocks (Alchemy free tier; fixtures/AUD-ANTIRUG-018-range-limit.ts); the control finds a launch with the RPC healthy; after a 12-block eth_blockNumber outage while the bot runs, every factory query asks pre-outage+1..head in one request and is refused, and a launch mined afterwards is never found within 60 s of fake time (claim outage-blinds-http-dex-poller). A poller catching up in backfillCapBlocks windows reads looks fixed. Not in the frozen 61; recorded so check.ts can locate its claim.
